name: smwsprites-controllable-growing-vine
title: Controllable Growing Vine
description:
A version of the growing vine sprite which can go up/left/down/right and also can use blocks to make it go faster or slower or change directions or even an option to make it dpad controllable like the coin snake.

Includes several sample blocks for controlling the vine, to use change the !Sprite define to match the slot you insert the vine on in the Pixi list.txt
